easyPrerequisites:
Down in the Valley's second chapter ability has resolved.
You control a land.
description:
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Scarland Thrinax's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Down in the Valley triggers, creating a 1/1 green Elf creature token
Resolve Scarland Thrinax's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
